about: Crouching Crown (katana.k_1l5), the one-handed string's last hit (KE task 12): Attack2H02's overhead, its whole circling wind-up (the blade raised high, swung down behind and up again: source frames 0-20 over 16), held at the top, then cut straight down to the ground in a deep bow, the hips dropped 18 cm into a deep crouch and held long (Elden Ring's last hit commits), then risen back to the guard. The clip is two-handed, as the pack keys it: the off hand joins the grip for the cut, set on the grip with the blade kept clear of the body. A step forward carries the body into the cut. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
